properties.description: Mapping Data Flow que reemplaza el CHashedFileStage (Hsh_Ext_Identification_Num) en J390_Movimiento_Compra_Monex_Hash de DataStage. Lee el archivo combinado Mov_Com desde ADLS, aplica el filtro de clave hash (NOT ISNULL de LTRIM(mmx_idc,'0'):UPPER(mmx_dig_vrf)) y carga los 23 campos en TMP_MOVCOM_MONEX en Teradata. La clave hash TMP_Ext_Identification_Num era solo la clave de particion del hash file DataStage y NO es una columna destino en Teradata.

sources.name: srcMovComMonex
sources.description: Archivo combinado Movimiento+Compra desde ADLS. Equivalente a Seq_Mov_Com_Monex (CSeqFileStage) en J390_Hash.

sinks.name: sinkTmpMovcomMonex
sinks.description: Tabla temporal Teradata TMP_MOVCOM_MONEX. Reemplaza CHashedFileStage + FL_Ext_Identification_Num (TeradataConnector FastLoad).

transformations.name: fltClaveHashNoNula
transformations.description: Filtro equivalente al Constraint DataStage: NOT(ISNULL(TRIM(TRIM(mmx_idc,'0','L')):TRIM(UPCASE(mmx_dig_vrf)))). Descarta filas donde la clave hash resultante seria nula (mmx_idc o mmx_dig_vrf blancos/nulos). En DataStage TRIM(str,'0','L') = LTRIM; UPCASE = UPPER.

typeProperties.script:
source(output(
    cnv_idn as string,
    mmx_srl as string,
    mmx_trx as string,
    mmx_idc as string,
    mmx_dig_vrf as string,
    mmx_cta_car as string,
    mmx_mto as string,
    mmx_fec_pag as string,
    mmx_fec_est_cua as string,
    mmx_mnd_ori as string,
    mmx_tip_cam as string,
    mmx_cod_err as string,
    mmx_fec_ctb as string,
    mmx_idn_ser as string,
    mmx_fec_pro_rec as string,
    cmx_idn_prd as string,
    cmx_cnt as string,
    cmx_prc as string,
    cmx_fec_cmp as string,
    cmx_frm_prd as string,
    cmx_num_fol as string,
    cmx_fec_vct as string,
    cmx_dsc_prd as string
),
allowSchemaDrift: false,
validateSchema: true,
ignoreNoFilesFound: false) ~> srcMovComMonex
srcMovComMonex filter(
    not(isNull(ltrim(trim(mmx_idc), '0') + ':' + upper(trim(mmx_dig_vrf))))
) ~> fltClaveHashNoNula
fltClaveHashNoNula sink(input(
    cnv_idn as string,
    mmx_srl as string,
    mmx_trx as string,
    mmx_idc as string,
    mmx_dig_vrf as string,
    mmx_cta_car as string,
    mmx_mto as decimal(18,4),
    mmx_fec_pag as timestamp,
    mmx_fec_est_cua as timestamp,
    mmx_mnd_ori as string,
    mmx_tip_cam as decimal(18,4),
    mmx_cod_err as string,
    mmx_fec_ctb as timestamp,
    mmx_idn_ser as string,
    mmx_fec_pro_rec as timestamp,
    cmx_idn_prd as string,
    cmx_cnt as integer,
    cmx_prc as decimal(18,4),
    cmx_fec_cmp as timestamp,
    cmx_frm_prd as string,
    cmx_num_fol as string,
    cmx_fec_vct as timestamp,
    cmx_dsc_prd as string
),
allowSchemaDrift: false,
validateSchema: true,
deletable: false,
insertable: true,
updateable: false,
upsertable: false,
recreate: true,
format: 'table',
skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true) ~> sinkTmpMovcomMonex
annotations: DataStage J390_Movimiento_Compra_Monex_Hash: Seq_Mov_Com_Monex -> Trf_Ext_Iden -> Hsh_Ext_Identification_Num -> FL_Ext_Identification_Num -> TMP_MOVCOM_MONEX
TMP_Ext_Identification_Num = TRIM(LTRIM(mmx_idc,'0')):TRIM(UPPER(mmx_dig_vrf)) era clave de particion hash (KeyPosition=1), NO columna Teradata
AccessMethod FastLoad (=2) en DataStage: en ADF se usa recreate=true en sink Teradata (truncate+insert)
